question: Who changed permissions in the last 7 days, and on what object?
Who has read the student, faculty or financial_aid tables recently?
Which principals were granted access this week, and by whom?
Show all access denials in the last 7 days

content: Access audit for the Platform Administrator (PA-05). Two tables, two different questions.

system.access.audit — WHO CHANGED a permission. Filter service_name='unityCatalog'. Key action_name values: updatePermissions (a grant or revoke), createCatalog, createSchema, deleteTable. The actor is user_identity.email. request_params holds securable_full_name (the object) and changes (a JSON array of principal + added/removed privileges). For denials, look for response.error_message containing PERMISSION_DENIED.

system.access.table_lineage — WHO ACTUALLY READ a table. created_by is the reader, source_table_full_name is the table. A grants list says who COULD read; this says who DID. That distinction is usually what an auditor is really asking.
ALWAYS filter on event_date — it is the partition column on both tables and they hold tens of millions of rows per week. Use event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS or similar.
Do NOT restrict to service_name='notebook' — that is a different scenario. Permission changes are recorded under service_name='unityCatalog'.
Answer with grouped summaries: who, what object, how many times, and when it last happened.
